gallus_wing_skeleton.species: Gallus gallus domesticus forelimb osteological specimen (stylopod humerus 1 element -> zeugopod radius+ulna 2 elements -> autopod carpometacarpus/digits II-IV 3 elements)
gallus_wing_skeleton.author: Conty / Wikimedia Commons

newman_frisch_1979_eigenmode_theory.helmholtz_eigenmode: Phi_{m,n}(x,y,z) = cos(m * pi * x / L_AP) * cos(n * pi * y / L_DV) * sin(pi * z / L_PD(t))
newman_frisch_1979_eigenmode_theory.dispersion_relation: k_{m,n}^2(L_PD) = (m * pi / L_AP)^2 + (n * pi / L_DV)^2 + (pi / L_PD(t))^2 = R / D_eff(t) = k_c^2

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = f_u(L_PD, D_eff) * u + f_v * v - u^3 + D_u * Lap(u)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = g_u(L_PD, D_eff) * u + g_v * v + D_v * Lap(v)
governing_pde.boundary_conditions: Zero-flux Neumann d_x u = 0 at x in {0, L_AP} (anterior/posterior ectoderm), d_y u = 0 at y in {0, L_DV} (dorsal/ventral ectoderm), pinned basal chondrogenic front u(z=0)=0 and apical AER boundary at z=L_PD(t)

developmental_stages_gallus_wing.empirical_source: Newman & Frisch (1979) Science 205:662-668 Table 1 & Fig. 2A (HH20-21, L_PD approx 0.5 mm -> m=1 stylopod humerus)
Newman & Frisch (1979) Science 205:662-668 Table 1 & Fig. 2B (HH24, L_PD approx 0.25 mm -> m=2 zeugopod radius+ulna)
Newman & Frisch (1979) Science 205:662-668 Table 1 & Fig. 2C (HH27-28 wing, L_PD approx 0.14 mm -> m=3 autopod digits II, III, IV)

developmental_stages_gallus_wing.compartment: Autopod (Hindlimb Pedal Digits I, II, III, IV)
developmental_stages_gallus_wing.empirical_source: Newman & Frisch (1979) Science 205:662-668 Table 1 (HH28 chick leg bud -> m=4 pedal digits I-IV)
